name: wbx-hud
description: Native status bar under the prompt and a sidebar: path, git, model, context, rate limits with their pace, running agents, tool feed

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: auto opens the sidebar at session start (docked on a wide terminal); manual only on /wbx-hud pane.

contextLevels.title: Context thresholds
contextLevels.description: Percentages from which the context ring turns yellow, orange and red, comma separated and ascending; repeat a value to skip a level. The settings tab's value wins.

fiveHourLevels.title: 5-hour limit thresholds
fiveHourLevels.description: Percentages from which the 5h ring turns yellow, orange and red, comma separated and ascending; repeat a value to skip a level. The settings tab's value wins.

sevenDayLevels.title: 7-day limit thresholds
sevenDayLevels.description: Percentages from which the 7d ring turns yellow, orange and red, comma separated and ascending; repeat a value to skip a level. The settings tab's value wins.
